name: XP Group
verdict: A private oil-and-gas production-enhancement group (formerly Expert Petroleum) backed by the Sukhtian family's GMS Holdings and chaired by Ghiath Sukhtian. No state in the chain, no human-rights finding against the company. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: propose 'none'. The link: XP Group is an investment of GMS Holdings, the family office of its chairman Ghiath Sukhtian, who has invested in the company for two decades (claim xp-gms-ownership, The Diplomat Bucharest + XP Group's own board page); a private family office, no state in the chain. The company's site does not state the ownership split — the exact stake is unknown and the claim says only what the sources say. No human-rights finding against the company was found (it advertises methane-emission reduction work; climate/operational records would not count under METHOD.md anyway). On the shirt: the white 'XP' mark with the pendulum graphic on the sleeve of Romania's current O'Neills home shirt matches XP Group's logo ('XP — Towards Sustainable Upstream Operations'), and XP Group (xp-group.com) is on the federation's partner bar (rugbyromania.ro footer).
